events.title: Fireside Chat with Joe Alterio
events.description:
CSEED is so excited to welcome Joe Alterio into UW! 🎨💻
Joe Alterio is a multidisciplinary creative working at the intersection of art, technology, design, and storytelling. With over 15 years of experience leading design and product teams, he has created digital products and experiences across industries like media, publishing, gaming, and technology.
Throughout his career, Joe has collaborated with major brands including Microsoft, Starbucks, Disney, Nickelodeon, Adobe, and Amazon. His work has received recognition from the Webby, Addy, and Anthem Awards and has been featured in The New York Times, The Atlantic, The Boston Globe, and the BBC.
Joe is also an accomplished speaker, having shared his insights at SXSW, San Diego Comic-Con, and other major events. He co-hosts the design podcast Designer & Designer and is passionate about creativity, collaboration, and building teams where people can do their best work.
Join us for an exciting conversation about creativity, design, technology, and what it means to build things that matter. Don’t miss this opportunity to learn from someone who has spent over 15 years pushing creative boundaries!
See you there!! 🌟
📅 Wednesday, November 18
🕟 4:30–6:30 PM
📍 CSE2 G10

events.title: BuildHer Expo
events.description:
cseed buildHER is hosting our last event of fall quarter - buildHER fall EXPO!!!
Come join us to explore Arduino, 3D modeling, Figma and more surrounded by a community of builders in a welcoming and inquisitive environment.
The expo will feature hands-on booths where you can dive into exploring these technologies, and leave having learned something new.
We hope to see you there!

events.title: Panel: HCI/HCDE Role Possibilities
events.description:
Join us in JHN 175 (Johnson Hall)
This panel will provide insight into all the different options and opportunities available to an HCDE/HCI+D or any UX graduate. Panelists will share their journeys, what their roles look like, and answer host questions. This will be followed by an audience Q&A and networking opportunities.

Speakers:
Emily Rapada - Senior Staff Researcher, Pinterest
Swati Sachdeva - SWE + Researcher, Google
Julianne Bryant - UX Senior Manager, Google
Sola Chang - Senior UX/UI Game Designer, Blizzard

This event will be in person only and will not be recorded. Please RSVP yes if you intend on coming in person, and if your plans change, please update your RSVP so our friends on the waitlist can join us :)
